_comment: Standard questions for the question map, and the rule-made phrasings per kind of source. {text}, {term}, {title} and {company} are filled in by plan.py; the model may phrase them better with plan --phrase.

opening.en: Hi, nice to meet you. Thanks for joining today.
opening.ko: 안녕하세요, 반갑습니다. 오늘 시간 내 주셔서 감사합니다.

opening.en: Could you turn on your camera?
Would you like to share your portfolio on screen?
How is your day going so far?
Sorry, could you say that again?
opening.ko: 죄송하지만 다시 한 번 말씀해 주시겠어요?

behavioral.en: Why are you looking for a new job now?
Tell me about a mistake you made and what you learned from it.
behavioral.ko: 실수한 경험과 거기서 배운 점을 말씀해 주세요.

behavioral.en: Tell me about a time you disagreed with a colleague or your manager.
behavioral.ko: 동료나 상사와 의견이 달랐던 경험을 말씀해 주세요.

behavioral.en: How do you decide what to do first when everything is urgent?
behavioral.ko: 모든 일이 급할 때 무엇부터 하시나요?

behavioral.en: Tell me about a time you had to learn something new quickly.
behavioral.ko: 새로운 것을 빨리 배워야 했던 경험을 말씀해 주세요.

behavioral.en: Tell me about a time you worked with a difficult customer.
behavioral.ko: 까다로운 고객과 일한 경험을 말씀해 주세요.

behavioral.en: Do you have any questions for us?

company.en: Why do you want to join {company}?

research.en: What do you know about this: {title}?

en: Tell me about your experience with this: {text}
Can you give a concrete example of doing this?
ko: 실제로 해 본 예를 들어 주시겠어요?

en: Your resume says: "{text}" Can you tell me more?
What exactly was your part in it?
ko: 이력서에 이렇게 쓰셨는데요: "{text}" 좀 더 설명해 주세요.
그중 본인이 직접 한 부분은 어디까지인가요?

en: What was your part, and what would you do differently now?
ko: 본인이 맡은 부분은 무엇이고, 지금 다시 한다면 무엇을 바꾸시겠어요?

en: How did you use {term} in your work?
